scenes.title: Feinstein, Adolphs & Damasio (2011/2013): Patient S.M. — Fearless to Snakes & Haunted Hous
scenes.era: 2011, Department of Neurology, University of Iowa Carver College of Medicine

layout.description: Justin Feinstein, Ralph Adolphs, Antonio Damasio, and Daniel Tranel (Current Biology 2011; Nature Neuroscience 2013) studied Patient S.M., a 44-year-old woman with complete bilateral amygdala destruction from Urbach-Wiethe disease who showed 0 out of 10 fear toward live snakes, tarantulas, and haunted-house monsters — until a single breath of 35% CO2 triggered her first panic attack in decades!
